image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a vintage audio cassette tape. The casing is made of translucent amber/brown plastic. It features two white spools visible through circular windows, a central rectangular window showing the magnetic tape, and handwritten text on the label area in black marker. The bottom edge shows the characteristic rectangular opening for the tape head and smaller circular indentations.
